newsitem.title: USA: Sigma Alpha and Batista in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Sigma Alpha and Batista in joint venture.

text.p: Sigma Alpha Group Ltd said Friday it has signed a letter of intent with the privately-held Batista Group to form a joint venture to market its voice information pager and other telecommunication products in Central and South America.
The company said a definitive joint venture agreement remains to be negotiated between the parties.

The agreement will provide that the Batista Group will have a 51 percent interest in the joint venture and the company will own the remaining 49 percent interest. It also provides for the purchase by the Batista Group of $5,000,000 of the company's restricted common shares at a price of $2.00 per share and the issuance of an option to acquire an additional $5,000,000 of restricted common shares at a price of $2.50 per share.
